snippet.title: Mexican Ninja - Launch Date Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
The Narkuzas have an army. You have Mexican Jutsus.

Mexican Ninja launches on August 20 for Steam, PlayStation and Xbox.

Fight through the neon streets of Nuevo Tokyo, build devastating combos, unlock powerful upgrades and tear through the Narkuza with increasingly ridiculous Mexican Jutsus.

Try the final pre-launch demo now on Steam and sharpen your skills before release.

Wishlist Mexican Ninja: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3764970/Mexican_Ninja/
Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4057760/Mexican_Ninja_Demo/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/TnREpYRrW8
Follow Mexican Ninja: linktr.ee/MexicanNinjaTheGame

Developed by Madbricks
Published by Amber
